hero.title: Edit your translations where you read them.
hero.subtitle: Alt-click any text in your running app, fix the wording, and the change lands in your locale JSON file. No backend, no database, no sync service.
hero.hint: Every line you see below is a key in a JSON file.
hero.tryLine: Turn inspect mode on with Alt+Shift+I, then Alt-click this sentence. It lives in en.json and changes the moment you press Ctrl+Enter.
hero.sampleLine: This sentence lives in en.json. Open the live demo and rewrite it from the page itself.

git.title: Your git stays the truth
git.body: Translation platforms keep your strings on their server and hand them back on their terms. This module writes straight into the files that already go through your review.

nothing.title: Nothing to run
nothing.body: No account, no service, no container to keep alive. The module lives inside your dev server and registers nothing at all in a production build.

writer.title: Built for whoever writes
writer.body: Whoever owns the words — a marketer, a designer, the founder — opens the app, sees the real layout at the real width, fixes the sentence and never waits for a developer to land a one-word change.

steps.heading: Three steps, no configuration
steps.one: Add the module to nuxt.config and start your dev server.
steps.two: Press Alt+Shift+I. Hover anything, the key shows up above it.
steps.three: Alt-click, edit, Ctrl+Enter. The file changes, the page updates.

signup.heading: A Pro version is coming
signup.body: Merge requests opened for you, edit history, roles and machine translation. The same local tool, with more in it. Leave your address to hear about it first.
signup.privacy: One message when it ships. Nothing else, ever.
signup.success: You are on the list. Thank you.
signup.label: Email address

errors.format: That does not look like an email address.

page.title: Leave requests
page.subtitle: Everything your team has asked for, in one place.

empty.title: Nothing in the archive yet
empty.body: Requests move here once they are closed. Nothing has been closed this year.

form.title: Ask for time off
form.sent: Sent. Well, it would be, if this demo had a backend.
form.errorDates: Pick both days, the first one and the last one.
form.errorComment: Tell your manager a little more, at least a sentence.

modal.title: Cancel this request?
modal.body: It disappears from your manager list. You can always ask again.

footer.tagline: A dev-only Nuxt module for editing translations in the running page. Your locale files stay the only source of truth.
footer.note: Every word on this page is a key in a JSON file. Edit one and watch the file change.
